# Beginner CG Artist

> Realistic, cinematic Blender environments, and how to build them step by step. Run by Salman, a Blender environment artist with 2+ years of experience. Everything is made by hand in Blender (Cycles), no AI. Tutorials, project files and scene packs.

Site: https://beginnercgartist.com
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BeginnerCGArtist
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/beginnercg_artist/
ArtStation: https://www.artstation.com/beginnercgartist
Gumroad: https://beginnercgartist.gumroad.com/

## About
- [About Salman](https://beginnercgartist.com/about): who makes this site, tools used (Blender 5.2, Cycles, Geometry Nodes, DaVinci Resolve, Photopea, OctaSpace cloud rendering) and what the work focuses on.
- [Contact](https://beginnercgartist.com/contact): custom environment work, collaborations, kit requests, Blender help.

## Tutorials
- [How to Create a Realistic Abandoned Gas Station in Blender](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/realistic-abandoned-gas-station): A full environment tutorial: build a realistic abandoned gas station from scratch.
- [Mistwood Giants: Giant Fantasy Forest Breakdown](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/giant-fantasy-forest-breakdown): How the giant fantasy forest environment was made in Blender.
- [Fantasy Library Environment Breakdown](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/fantasy-library-breakdown): A breakdown of the fantasy library scene, rendered with OctaSpace.
- [How to Post Process Blender Renders for FREE](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/post-process-blender-renders-photopea): Finish your renders for free using Photopea.
- [Free Procedural Vine Generator Add-on for Blender](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/procedural-vine-generator-addon): Installation and a tutorial for the free Procedural Vine Generator add-on.
- [10 Blender Tips & Tricks Every Beginner Should Know](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/10-blender-tips-for-beginners): Ten practical tips that make working in Blender faster.
- [How to Make a Realistic Flag Animation in Blender in 2 Minutes](https://beginnercgartist.com/tutorials/realistic-flag-animation-2-minutes): A quick beginner tutorial for a realistic waving flag.

## Portfolio
- [Frog Island](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/frog-island): Two giant stone frogs guard a waterfall pond. Viewport to final Cycles render.
- [Abandoned Gas Station](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/abandoned-gas-station): A realistic roadside gas station, built from scratch with a full tutorial.
- [Mistwood Giants](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/mistwood-giants): A giant fantasy forest environment with a full breakdown.
- [Fantasy Library](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/fantasy-library): An interior fantasy library environment, rendered on a cloud GPU.
- [Dreamy Sunflower Field](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/dreamy-sunflower-field): A sunflower field with a farmhouse, made in Blender 5.2 with Cycles.
- [Fantasy Environment](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/fantasy-environment-timelapse): A fantasy environment from empty scene to final render, as a timelapse.
- [Dreamy Hilltop Morning](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/dreamy-hilltop-morning): A semi-realistic hilltop morning with a slow cinematic camera move.
- [Abandoned Farm](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/abandoned-farm): Abandoned Farm Environment – Cinematic Blender Scene. The scene file is available on Gumroad.
- [Lakeside Mountain Monastery](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/lakeside-mountain-monastery): Lakeside Mountain Monastery – Cinematic 3D Environment. The scene file is available on Gumroad.
- [Forgotten Tracks](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/forgotten-tracks): Forgotten Tracks – Hyper Realistic Forest Environment (Blender). The scene file is available on Gumroad.
- [Dark Fantasy Castle](https://beginnercgartist.com/portfolio/dark-fantasy-castle): Dark Fantasy Castle Environment. The scene file is available on Gumroad.

## Blog
- [How I Started in Blender, and Where I Am Now](https://beginnercgartist.com/blog/how-i-started-in-blender-and-where-i-am-now): A short, honest look at two-plus years of learning Blender, why I focus on environments, and what I am working on today.
- [What I Am Working On Next: Goals for the Channel and the Library](https://beginnercgartist.com/blog/whats-next-goals-for-the-channel-and-library): The plan for the coming months: more realistic environments, kits and shader packs, free starter files, and a steady upload schedule.
- [What You Get When You Join the List](https://beginnercgartist.com/blog/what-you-get-when-you-join-the-list): What the list includes, what it does not, and how your details are handled. Short and clear.

## Topics
Blender, environment art, realistic environments, Cycles rendering, procedural materials, Geometry Nodes, vegetation scattering, cinematic lighting, volumetrics, post-processing, Blender add-ons, project files.
